lines.rom: om jaya srisyama hare prabhu jaya srisyama hare nija bhaktana ke tumane purana kama kare
gala puspom ki mala sira para mukata dhare pita basana pitambara kundala karna pare
ratnasimhasana rajata sevaka bhakta khare khevata dhupa agina para dipaka jyoti jare
modaka khira curama suvarna thala bhare sevaka bhoga lagavata sira para camvara dhure
jhamjha nagara aura ghariyavala samkha mrdamga ghure bhakta arati gavem jaya jayakara kare

jo dhyave phala pave saba duhkha se ubare sevaka jaba nija mukha se srisyama syama ucare
srisyama bihariji ki arati jo koi nara gave gavata dasamanohara mana vamchita phala pave
